text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Approaching the final stretch!
Where will Yamanin Zephyr make her move?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (—I am by no means a strong Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(She possesses neither standout talent
nor a privileged environment—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (It was precisely because I was conscious of it... that I ran.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Relying thoroughly on management and maintenance, she strove to run more than anyone else to grow stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Ever since I met Trainer, we've joined forces and taken on so many races...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I got stronger by running...!
I've gained more experience than anyone else...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (—I recognize this flow.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The experiences I've built up...!
My past self is...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(It points toward
what is possible in the future—!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (If the flow of this race is also going to take the form indicated――)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...! Oh no!
At this rate, they'll make their move first!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I will not let you!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Ikuno Dictus!!
Ikuno Dictus is moving up!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus crosses the finish line!!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoaaa!
She beat Yamanin Zephyr in a head-to-head showdown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's seriously amazing...! This really
raises my hopes for the Takarazuka Kinen~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
You really are something else...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My, you certainly know how to fire me up—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I did it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I won...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to all my experience up until now,
I was able to notice Zephyr-san's move...——)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (...Indeed, it is precisely this experience that...—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Like a steel blade carving through the wind—
it was a sharp, fierce run."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To be able to compete with your gale-like running today...
I am truly glad.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Same here.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I would like to... compete with you again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I face you on the track...
I can feel the wind even more intensely—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I am honored.
...We shall surely race again."
And so, Ikuno Dictus brilliantly proved her strength at the mile distance in the Yasuda Kinen.
—The day after the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
“—Fatigue accumulation is within baseline limits.
As a precaution, I recommend reducing training
intensity until the Takarazuka Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Understood. ...It appears the strain from the Yasuda Kinen was kept lower than expected.
choice_data_list: It just shows how much stronger you've become.
It just shows how much stronger you've become.

text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus had grown vastly stronger compared to when we first set the goal of running four races: the Spring Senior Triple Crown and the Yasuda Kinen.

With how Ikuno Dictus is right now,
she should be able to head into the imminent Takarazuka Kinen
in perfect condition...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...It's finally here, isn't it?
Our destination for this spring—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: And... another race where I can compete head-to-head with McQueen-san at medium distance...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

—The decisive Grand Prix, the 'Takarazuka Kinen,'
is right around the corner.
